entry.title: Kentucky Fire Cured Sweets Chunky
entry.summaryHtml: Maple sweetness, hickory smoke, oak, barbecue, bourbon and savoury tobacco define the Sweets blend in a thicker 4″ × 46 format. The sweetened cap softens the fire-cured Kentucky character while the broader ring gives the smoky, woody core more body than the Ponies, with a lingering maple-bacon style finish.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index currently lists the exact 4″ × 46 Sweets Chunky single at A$37.80 and available. Cigar Hut lists the same size at A$45.
